title: Debbie B NDE 5134
content: In my first experience, I remember opening my eyes and seeing my husband standing a distance from me. Suddenly I had the sensation of falling. I thought I was hollering 'No!' But, my husband said I made no sound. I was met by my mother who had passed two years earlier. From a distance, I saw family members that had also passed. My mother told me to come with her. We walked down this long sandy path. When I saw a clearing, I heard a sound from behind me that made me stop in my tracks. I was told that it was not my time yet - that my husband and I had a lot to do and that many people would be counting on us. I then woke up in the intensive care unit. The other time it happened to me was the seventh cardiac arrest I had. This time I had an out of body experience. I found myself going back to my house where the doctor had told my husband and sons to go and rest until morning. I touched each of my sons on the cheek as they were sleeping. When I went to kiss my husband, the phone rang. It was 5:02 am. Suddenly I woke up back in my hospital room with the doctor telling me in my ear that he was putting in a temporary pace maker and medical evacuating me to another hospital. I was in critical condition and not expected to make it.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Falling sensation; walking down a long sandy path.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Told it was not her time; she and her husband had a lot to do and many people would be counting on them.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Narrative mentions multiple cardiac arrests; the second described event occurred during the seventh cardiac arrest.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: First experience included a falling sensation and walking down a long sandy path; second experience included visiting home and touching/kissing family while out of body.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: First: opened eyes, saw husband, falling sensation, met deceased mother and saw other deceased family, walked down sandy path, stopped by a sound/voice saying it was not her time, woke in ICU. Second: OBE to home, interacted with sleeping sons and husband, phone rang at 5:02 am, woke back in hospital as doctor spoke.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Two separate NDEs (first and later during seventh cardiac arrest).

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: In the second NDE, she went to her house, touched each sleeping son on the cheek, and as she went to kiss her husband the phone rang (5:02 am), then she woke back in the hospital with the doctor speaking in her ear.
